nodes.statement: Fix one independently admitted bearer, interval, target, consumer and selected bodily/action slice, with actual same-lineage retained history H, actual present use U, positive test E and positive report R kept as distinct Boolean sorts.
nodes.scope: Sixteen declared profiles for one same-instance slice; not a complete human or artificial organization.
nodes.quantifier: For every Boolean bridge on this one finite domain.

nodes.statement: Require invariance to E/R, two H/U difference contrasts, and one nonjoint baseline equivalence without naming either target pole.
nodes.scope: R193:DOMAIN only; equality/difference constraints are fixed before bridge enumeration.
nodes.quantifier: For all nuisance E/R values and all listed contrast edges.

nodes.statement: The constraint ladder compresses 65,536 Boolean bridges to 16, then 4, then the complementary pair H AND U and NOT(H AND U).
nodes.scope: Exact declared finite model only; not an empirical estimate.

nodes.statement: Name-free equality/difference constraints preserve B to 1-B symmetry and therefore identify at most an unoriented partition.
nodes.scope: Constraint packages invariant under global Boolean complement.
nodes.quantifier: For every compatible B, its complement is compatible absent an anchor.

nodes.statement: A positive-pole anchor can orient the partition only if its experiential and measurement interpretation is independently warranted.
nodes.scope: One fixed component of the signed constraint graph; marker polarity alone is insufficient.
nodes.quantifier: For any proposed anchor, require independent target and reliability justification.

nodes.statement: Given the declared positive anchor, the unique Boolean structural coordinate is H AND U; its familiar-mineness name remains a separate bridge obligation.
nodes.scope: The selected R193 slice, not basal experience or a complete phenomenal vocabulary.
nodes.quantifier: Unique among Boolean bridges satisfying every declared package.

nodes.statement: Even a structurally unique anchored coordinate is not thereby correctly named familiar mineness; anchor polarity and target interpretation require independent support.
nodes.scope: The R193 structural coordinate and its proposed experiential interpretation.
nodes.quantifier: For every proposed marker or orientation anchor.

nodes.statement: Actual use U, positive test E, report R and a named experiential target are distinct; tests are evidence and do not install use or define experience.
nodes.scope: One route and diagnostic/report protocol without an added reliability premise.
nodes.quantifier: All four U/E pairs remain logically representable.

nodes.statement: Future familiar-mineness work must separately discharge bridge compression, polarity orientation, semantic naming and actual measurement/admission.
nodes.scope: UCT bodily/action-mineness research; no basal-experience gate or unique owner.
nodes.quantifier: For every future named-target application using this contrast route.

rules.statement: Enumerate the fixed domain under all simultaneous predeclared constraints and retain the inherited fiber/target typing.
rules.binding: The bearer, interval, target, consumer, H/U/E/R meaning and constraint package remain fixed throughout.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: No alternative route; every all_of premise is simultaneous.

rules.statement: Apply the complement automorphism to the name-free compatible bridge set.
rules.binding: Only target labels are complemented; organization, evidence domain and constraints remain fixed.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: An oriented anchor is intentionally absent from this rule.

rules.statement: Orient the single signed-constraint component only after an independent anchor and retain coordinate transport.
rules.binding: The anchor concerns the same bearer, interval, component and target; marker evidence is not substituted for target meaning.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: Without the anchor only the complementary pair follows.

rules.statement: Keep actual history/use relations distinct from diagnostic and report variables on the same bound slice.
rules.binding: H requires actual occurrence, lineage and continuation; U requires the actual present consumer; E/R remain evidence/output.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: A reliability bridge may support inference but cannot redefine use as test success.

rules.statement: Record that structural uniqueness relative to an anchor does not discharge the anchor's familiar-mineness interpretation.
rules.binding: The structural coordinate and named phenomenal target remain different sorts; this records an obligation rather than deriving its truth.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: No inference from H AND U to B_fam is licensed.

rules.statement: Use the jointly scoped exact result, symmetry boundary, semantic residual, evidence typing and inherited open bridge to govern future work.
rules.binding: Finite proof, actual relation membership, target semantics and measurement evidence remain separate evidence grades.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: No individual premise independently yields the protocol or B_fam.

context_links.statement: R193 supplies a finite contrast package inside the established representation/fiber discipline.
A transported coordinate is not thereby correctly named familiar mineness.
History requires actual occurrence, lineage, continuation and present use; copied value is insufficient.
No H/U contrast, anchor, test, report or familiar-mineness bridge is required for basal nonempty experience.
C1 remains a project axiom; the finite enumeration neither proves nor replaces it.
